description: A full-scale single-storey cavity-wall specimen represents the upper portion of a Dutch terraced house. Acceleration and displacement records describe the response of a building segment without seismic detailing. The dataset is provided by LNEC, Lisbon through BED. BED assigns the experiment to 2017.
